option_relations.rationale: Acute coronary syndrome (non-ST-elevation or ST-elevation myocardial infarction) is a distinct cardiac condition not directly related to the provided leaf of Cardiac tamponade.
ST-segment elevation due to myocardial metastasis from squamous cell carcinoma of the lung describes a cause of ST elevation, which is not directly related to the provided leaf of Cardiac tamponade.
Cardiac metastasis from lung cancer (intracardiac mass) describes a tumor, which is not directly related to the provided leaf of Cardiac tamponade.
Metastatic cardiac tumor (secondary to lung cancer) describes a tumor, which is not directly related to the provided leaf of Cardiac tamponade.
